title: Everyday Phrases — Visiting a Sick Friend
title_quote: Excuse me, where is the information desk?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏥 實用「醫院探望」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Visiting a Sick Friend
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「醫院探望」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是病房：去醫院看朋友：在櫃檯登記訪客、帶點水果上樓，問問他今天感覺如何、聊聊家裡的近況，護士來量體溫時先讓一讓，離開前交代有事隨時打電話。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Visiting a Sick Friend' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Visiting a friend in hospital: signing in at the desk, asking how he feels today, chatting about home, stepping aside for the nurse, and leaving a number in case he needs anything. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where is the information desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi wɛr ɪz ði ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，請問服務台在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's right beside the front door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm here to visit a friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May I have his room number?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His name is Kevin Chen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the list first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could he be in room five twelve?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd hi bi ɪn rum faɪv twɛlv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's on the fifth floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are the visiting hours today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From ten in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I go up right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but please sign here first.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但請先在這裡簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like to see my ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju laɪk tə si maɪ aɪˈdi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please show me your card.
dialogue.zh: 是的，請讓我看你的證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my visitor badge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear it until you leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I find the elevator?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's behind that white wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take the stairs instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the elevator is faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd like to buy some fruit first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə baɪ səm frut fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a shop downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much are the oranges?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten dollars for a bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the apples fresh today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they came this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll take six apples.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fourteen dollars, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, cash only here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you get me a paper bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju ɡɛt mi ə ˈpeɪpər bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以幫我拿個紙袋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here is a big one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the shop still be open later?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ʃɑp stɪl bi ˈoʊpən ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 那家店晚一點還開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It closes at eight tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll hurry upstairs now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the elevator on your left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button goes to the fifth floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈbʌtən ɡoʊz tə ðə fɪfθ flɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one with the number five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way leads to room five twelve?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ lidz tu rum faɪv twɛlv?/
dialogue.zh: 哪條路可以到五一二號房？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just follow the green line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hallway is really quiet today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most patients are resting now.
dialogue.zh: 大部分病人現在在休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep my voice down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please speak very softly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll leave my bag outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the room is quite small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes the nurse with a chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr kʌmz ðə nɜrs wɪð ə tʃɑrt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She checks every room at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, are you his nurse?
dialogue.zh: 早安，你是他的護理師嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I take care of him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long has he been here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He came in on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was his accident very serious?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He broke his left arm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he eat normal food now?
dialogue.zh: 他現在可以吃一般食物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but he eats very little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could he be sleeping right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he just woke up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I step into his room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he need any medicine now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not until four this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring him some water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm water would be better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has his fever gone this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it dropped last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will visitors have to wear a mask?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ˈvɪzɪtərz hæv tə wɛr ə mæsk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please wear one near him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I sit in there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the chair by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he get to walk around?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only with someone beside him.
dialogue.zh: 只有在有人陪同時才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he sleep well at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, he wakes often.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which doctor is treating him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doctor Wang comes every morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will his family come by today?
dialogue.zh: 他的家人今天會過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His sister comes after work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring him some soup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but nothing too spicy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are flowers allowed in the room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, flowers are not allowed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll just bring the fruit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit is always a good choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he still feel much pain?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, mostly at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he go home this week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe on Friday, if tests pass.
dialogue.zh: 如果檢查過關，也許星期五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should I come back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back around three o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wait outside for a while.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a seat near the desk.
dialogue.zh: 在櫃台附近找個位子坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you call me if he wakes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju kɔl mi ɪf hi weɪks?/
dialogue.zh: 如果他醒了，可以叫我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I'll come and tell you.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs aɪl kʌm ənd tɛl ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, that's very kind of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðæts ˈvɛri kaɪnd əv ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my job, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is he feeling this morning?
dialogue.zh: 他今天早上覺得怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's a bit tired today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see him for a moment?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si hɪm fər ə ˈmoʊmənt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he's waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Knock knock, may I come in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come in, the door is open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Kevin, how are you feeling?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better than last week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought you some fruit today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You really didn't have to.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These apples are for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, they look very fresh.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is your left arm now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It still hurts a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the cast feel too tight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, but it's okay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you move your fingers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a little bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the doctor say anything new?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He said the bone is healing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like good news.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm quite relieved.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How well do you sleep here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not much, it's noisy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the food here taste good?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's plain, but I eat it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like some warm water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my throat is dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me pour you a cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the table is small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like some fresh air?
dialogue.zh: 你想要一點新鮮空氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, some fresh air helps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the room feel too cold?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, please close it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn the light off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I want to read.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are you reading these days?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a book about travel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you bored in here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, the days feel long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there many people visiting you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only my sister and you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does your phone work in here?
dialogue.zh: 你的手機在這裡收得到訊號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the signal is weak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I text your sister later?
dialogue.zh: 要我晚點傳訊息給你妹妹嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tell her I'm fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need anything from home?
dialogue.zh: 你需要家裡帶什麼來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe my blue sweater tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 也許明天帶我那件藍色毛衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can bring it in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn brɪŋ ɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would help me a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You look a little tired now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am, I just came back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you go just now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They took me for a scan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the scan take a long time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə skæn teɪk ə lɔŋ taɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost an hour, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was it uncomfortable for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, I had to stay still.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪt aɪ hæd tə steɪ stɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to rest now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm really sleepy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I come back later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, stay a little longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close your eyes if you want.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe I will in a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you in any pain right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ɪn ˈɛni peɪn raɪt naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just very heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I tell the nurse?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, let me rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need another pillow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one more would help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this pillow feel high enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little higher, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does that feel now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better, thank you so much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're already falling asleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I can't stay awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't say sorry, just sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wake me before you leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll sit here quietly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, just ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you asleep already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, my eyes are heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I close the curtain?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the light is bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wait outside for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, come back at three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is he doing in there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's sleeping now, finally.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that seem normal after a scan?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt sim ˈnɔrməl ˈæftər ə skæn?/
dialogue.zh: 做完檢查出現這樣算正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he needs the rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he wake up soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably in an hour or two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I wait in this hall?
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這條走廊等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there are some chairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I come back at three?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three is a good time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, is there coffee on this floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪz ðɛr ˈkɔfi ɑn ðɪs flɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, near the elevator.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll get a cup and wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, don't rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please call me when he wakes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, enjoy your coffee.
dialogue.zh: 我會的，好好喝你的咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for looking after him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's a very good patient.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This coffee tastes a little bitter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add some sugar to it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall is getting busy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lunch time is near.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know when he will wake?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju noʊ wɛn hi wɪl weɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 你知道他什麼時候會醒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He usually sleeps an hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope he's not in pain.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His medicine is still working.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was his scan result good?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The doctor will explain later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I ask him about it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better not, he needs rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're right, I'll just chat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Talking about home helps him.
dialogue.zh: 聊家裡的事對他有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard him moving inside.
dialogue.zh: 我聽到他在裡面有動靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he might be awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello again, did you sleep well?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，又見面了，你睡得好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, my arm itches.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, is the cast bothering you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right under my wrist.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get something for that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the nurse for powder.
dialogue.zh: 問護理師有沒有痱子粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll go and ask her now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't run in the hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't worry, I'll walk slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, you're too kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you dream about anything?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I dreamed about my old bike.
dialogue.zh: 我夢到我那台舊腳踏車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you still riding to work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not for a few months.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can drive you when you leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn draɪv ju wɛn ju liv./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's really nice of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has your sister called today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she called this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, is she coming after work again?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ʃi ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈæftər wɜrk əˈɡɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She said she'd try tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your mother must be worried too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She calls me every single day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they live far from here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About two hours by train.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you hungry at all now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, maybe some soup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw a soup shop downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 我在樓下看到一家賣湯的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then get me a small bowl.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which do you want, chicken or beef?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ du ju wɑnt ˈtʃɪkɪn ɔr bif?/
dialogue.zh: 你要哪一種，雞肉還是牛肉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chicken, please, not too salty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be back in fifteen minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No hurry, take your time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is the smallest bowl?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's enough for one person.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got your chicken soup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells really good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, is it too hot to drink?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪz ɪt tu hɑt tə drɪŋk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need help with the spoon?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid hɛlp wɪð ðə spun?/
dialogue.zh: 你需要人幫你拿湯匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My right hand is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold the bowl steady?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but please move the table.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但請把桌子移過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, is the table close enough now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪz ðə ˈteɪbəl kloʊs ɪˈnʌf naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there more water you want?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my cup is empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add some warm water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a little, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I fluff your pillow again?
dialogue.zh: 我可以再幫你拍鬆枕頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it went flat again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, is your neck comfortable now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I raise the bed a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ reɪz ðə bɛd ə bɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that would help me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the button for that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here by my hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How high do you want it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a little bit higher.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me if it hurts your arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ɪf ɪt hɜrts jʊr ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 如果弄痛你的手就告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine, keep going.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, is this angle better for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪz ðɪs ˈæŋɡəl ˈbɛtər fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 這個角度對你比較好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can breathe easier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does your back feel sore?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little from lying down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I rub your shoulders?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gently, my left side hurts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the soup by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz ðə sup baɪ ðə weɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really good, I finished it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like some of the apples?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju laɪk səm əv ði ˈæpəlz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe later, I'm full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll leave them on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I'll eat one tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about your work lately.
dialogue.zh: 跟我說說你最近的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They told me not to worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, is your team covering for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz jʊr tim ˈkʌvərɪŋ fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 你的團隊有幫你代班嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Amy took my project.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That must be a relief for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt mʌst bi ə rɪˈlif fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, I sleep better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you been missing your own bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju bɪn ˈmɪsɪŋ jʊr oʊn bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 你一直想念自己的床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every single night, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'll be home very soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope Friday works out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, is there anything else you need?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls ju nid?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could you open the curtain a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju ˈoʊpən ðə ˈkɜrtən ə ˈlɪtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 可以把簾子拉開一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I'm here for your temperature.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi aɪm hɪr fər jʊr ˈtɛmpərətʃər./
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我來幫你量體溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, my mouth is ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please hold it under your tongue.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long should I hold it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only for one more minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's not very long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your temperature is almost normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has been down since morning.
dialogue.zh: 從早上到現在一直是降下來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a good sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the medicine is working.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you feeling hot right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I feel quite cool.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your blood pressure looks fine too.
dialogue.zh: 你的血壓看起來也正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a big relief.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you drinking enough water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My friend keeps filling my cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, keep doing that today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is your arm feeling now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It only aches at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring you a painkiller later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that helps a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need anything else now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just some quiet, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll close the door then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please leave it a little open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should let you rest soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can stay a bit more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cafeteria closes at seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we should eat early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring your sweater tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我明天把你的毛衣帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You remembered, that's great.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring your charger as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju brɪŋ jʊr ˈtʃɑrdʒər əz wɛl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, mine stopped working.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll put it in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't forget the apples either.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They're right here on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll eat one after dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your sweater is on the chair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I almost forgot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Get some sleep tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll try my best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the doctor come by again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He usually comes around five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I be here for that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a family member should.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His sister will come tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, she can hear the result.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, is his test result ready yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪz hɪz tɛst rɪˈzʌlt ˈrɛdi jɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 他的檢查結果出來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should be ready by five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does everything look normal so far?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nothing looks serious.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So he can go home Friday?
dialogue.zh: 所以他星期五可以回家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If today's tests stay good.
dialogue.zh: 如果今天的檢查都正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the best news today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He'll be happy to hear it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wake him to tell him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪk hɪm tə tɛl hɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let him sleep a bit more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is waking up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then I can tell him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I find some paper?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a pad by the phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll write a short message.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it cheerful and simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the lamp too bright?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he sleeps better in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi slips ˈbɛtər ɪn ðə dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 對，他在暗一點的地方睡得比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, is the window still open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a little, for air.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll close it before I go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not too much, he likes the breeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt tu mʌtʃ hi laɪks ðə briz/
dialogue.zh: 不用太多，他喜歡有點風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the nurse come back?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm dʌz ðə nɜrs kʌm bæk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around five, with his medicine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will someone bring him dinner?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, dinner comes at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he eat by himself now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, his right hand works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel much better leaving now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's in good hands here.
dialogue.zh: 他在這裡受到很好的照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll come back on Friday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring him something to read.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a magazine be a good idea?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ə ˈmæɡəzin bi ə ɡʊd aɪˈdiə?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He likes sports magazines a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll buy one on my way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will enjoy that very much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call me if you need anything.
dialogue.zh: 需要什麼就打電話給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, thank you for today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you warm enough now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, may I have a blanket?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl meɪ aɪ hæv ə ˈblæŋkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 有一點，可以給我一條毯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will head home now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me when you get home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, in about an hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take care, and thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you on Friday then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you, and drive safely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I left the apples on your table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɛft ði ˈæpəlz ɑn jʊr ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我把蘋果留在你桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw them and smiled.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my visit went well today.
dialogue.zh: 那今天這趟探訪很順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It truly made my day.
dialogue.zh: 你真的讓我今天很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your sister will be glad too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She worries about me constantly.

issues.note: 小懸空（風格級，非矛盾）：387『A little, may I have a blanket?』的請求未被回應，388 直接『I will head home now.』；386-390 的照料插拍把 389-393 的告別鏈切成兩段。可合理化為臨別順口、毯子稍後由護理師送來，但聽感上像是被略過，建議補一句 a 的回應或把 386-387 移回前面。

聲位瞬轉：377／379／381 由 char_b 以第三人稱談病人（He's in good hands here／Bring him something to read／He likes sports magazines a lot），383 同一把聲音改口成病人本人『I will enjoy that very much.』。依本 brief，聲部非固定角色、聲位切換不算缺陷，故不列 error；但兩行內由『他』變『我』，聽者易短暫失焦，建議改『He'll enjoy that a lot.』。
語序不道地：260『Is there more water you want?』為中文式倒裝殘留，母語者說『Do you want any more water?』或『Would you like more water?』。
問句模板密度偏高：『So／Now／Well／And + , + is …』共 9 次（192、218、252、258、266、276、298、348、366），其中 218／276『And, is …』逗號起句最不自然；『Should I …?』約 13 次。皆為 A2 常用結構、語意清楚，故不列 error，建議輪換一半。

近重複（非整句重複，故機器未攔）：298『Now, is there anything else you need?』與 322『Do you need anything else now?』幾乎同句換序；090『I'll wait outside for a while.』vs 180『…for a bit.』；『三點回來』動機出現三次（088-090、180-181、190-191），建議其一換時間或換話題。
物件連續性微瑕：330『I'll bring your sweater tomorrow.』與 338『Your sweater is on the chair.』同一趟探視內並存（明天才帶 vs 已在椅上），可解讀為兩件毛衣／入院時自帶，非硬矛盾；另 044『I'll leave my bag outside.』與 334『I'll put it in my bag.』亦為同類小落差。
003 問『May I have his room number?』，004 答的是姓名（His name is Kevin Chen.）；可解讀為以姓名代查房號（005 Let me check the list first.），屬小落差非矛盾。

機器唯一風格信號具名合理化：64『Has his fever gone this morning?』用法正確、65『Yes, it dropped last night.』呼應，非 'never' 筆誤；126『Would you like some fresh air?』／127『Yes, some fresh air helps.』一對內重複 fresh air 為自然回聲，364 改為『Is the lamp too bright?』後未見與外題整句重複。

review.summary_zh: 本輪四項修正核實成立：①386-390 的『還要什麼／毯子』已移到送別之前，392-393『See you on Friday then.／See you, and drive safely.』成為唯一最後一拍，其後直接接 394-399 病人視角收束，結尾乾淨、無 Thank you./Goodbye. 三連；②328-329 改為『The cafeteria closes at seven.／Then we should eat early.』、338-339 改為『Your sweater is on the chair.／Thanks, I almost forgot.』，兩處小道別預演已消除；③126、364 已避開外題近似句。全篇逐項核對（Kevin Chen、512 房／五樓、左臂骨折右手可用、訪客證口罩、14 元現金、週五出院與週五上午再來、蘋果毛衣、妹妹與母親、五點檢驗結果、三點回訪）前後一致，未見 error 級矛盾；僅剩毯子請求未回應、383 聲位瞬轉、260 語序、問句模板密度與 298/322 近重複等風格小瑕，已逐條具名合理化。IPA 維度依機器證據給滿分（全庫詞→IPA 多數表決 SUSPECT 0、逐詞對齊與 IPA 形狀通過、hard=0，本輪未見反例）。
